nativeBaseline.reference: listbox with multiple selection and explicit option semantics

library: Separate focus, selected values and open state; expose selection summary and removal relationships.
consumer: Author names, option values and form labels; own domain filtering and data loading.

notes: Native auto popover and CSS anchor placement preserve selection and focus independence. Space/Enter toggle eligible options without closing the popup; outside dismissal does not change selection.
React/Vue popup remains mounted while closed. Custom form participation, deterministic generated relationships, selection summaries and removal relationships remain separate work.
Audit mapping is provisional; not a conformance claim.
